'''Amir Minniakhmetovich Ishemgulov''' ({{langx|ru|Амир Минниахметович Ишемгулов}}; 22 May 1960 – 29 October 2020) was a Russian biologist and politician of [[Bashkirs|Bashkir]] ethnicity,<ref name="gsrb.ru"/> [[Doktor nauk|Doctor of Biological Sciences]],<ref name="pravo.gov.ru">{{Cite web|url=http://pravo.gov.ru/proxy/ips/?doc_itself=&&nd=102120485&&page=1&rdk=0#I0|title=О награждении государственными наградами Российской Федерации|trans-title=On awarding state awards of the Russian Federation|language=ru|website=pravo.gov.ru|access-date=2019-12-08|date=2015-11-23}}</ref><ref name="gsrb.ru"/><ref name="Kremlin">{{Cite web|url=http://kremlin.ru/acts/bank/27045|title=Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 17.03.2008 г. № 357|trans-title=Decree of the President of the Russian Federation of March 17, 2008 No. 357|website=Президент России|language=ru|access-date=2019-12-08|date=2008-03-17}}</ref> professor.<ref name="Kremlin" /><ref name="pravo.gov.ru"/><ref name="gsrb.ru"/>

==Early life and education==
Ishemgulov was born on 22 May 1960, in [[Bashkortostan]], [[RSFSR]], [[Soviet Union]].<ref name="gsrb.ru">{{Cite web|url=http://gsrb.ru/ru/press-center/news/35991/|title=Депутат Государственного Собрания избран Председателем Исполкома Всемирного курултая башкир|trans-title=Member of the State Assembly elected Chairman of the Executive Committee of the World Kurultai Bashkir|website=gsrb.ru|access-date=2019-12-08}}</ref>

He was a distant relative of the writer [[Zainab Biisheva]].<ref name="gsrb.ru"/> She took part in his upbringing. He was ethnically Bashkir.<ref name="gsrb.ru"/> In 1984, he graduated with honors from the [[Bashkir State Agrarian University|Bashkortostan Institute of Agricultural Sciences]].<ref name="gsrb.ru"/>

==Career==
He was the chairman of the executive committee of [[the World Qoroltai of the Bashkirs]],<ref name="gsrb.ru"/> and Director General of the [[Bashkir Scientific Research Center for Beekeeping and Apitherapy|Research Center for Beekeeping and Apitherapy of The Republic of Bashkortostan]].<ref name="pravo.gov.ru"/><ref name="gsrb.ru"/><ref name="Kremlin" /> He also is a member of the [[State Assembly of the Republic of Bashkortostan]]<ref name="gsrb.ru"/> and a Member of the Petrovskaya Academy of Sciences and Arts.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.gmdu.net/corp-494803.html|title=State Establishment Bashkirian Scientific Research Center On Beekeeping and Apitherapy|website=Global Manufacturers|language=en-US|access-date=2019-12-08}}</ref>

Since 1998, the Director of the [[Bashkir Scientific Research Center for Beekeeping and Apitherapy|Research Center for Beekeeping and Apitherapy of The Republic of Bashkortostan]],<ref name="gsrb.ru"/> he has initiated the creation of the center. In 2005, Ishemgulov defended his doctoral dissertation and earned the degree of [[Doktor nauk]] and in 2006 he received the title of Professor. Currently he is a professor in his alma mater, now known as [[Bashkir State Agrarian University]].

In 2012, he was a candidate for Corresponding Member of the Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Bashkortostan.<ref>[http://www.anrb.ru/blog/Item/2305/8 Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Bashkortostan] official site (in Russian)</ref>

He was elected to the [[State Assembly of the Republic of Bashkortostan]] in 2013, Member of the Party "[[United Russia]]".<ref name="gsrb.ru"/>

He was a Honored Man of agriculture of Republic Bashkortostan.<ref name="gsrb.ru"/>

==Later life and death==
He was married and had a daughter.<ref name="gsrb.ru"/> On 29 October 2020, Ishemgulov died after a long illness at the age of 60.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://proufu.ru/news/society/97924-v_bashkirii_umer_deputat_gossobraniya_amir_ishemgulov/ |title=В Башкирии умер депутат Госсобрания Амир Ишемгулов|website=ProUfu.ru|access-date=29 October 2020|language=ru}}</ref>
